classic:
#set page(paper: "a4", margin: 0pt)
#set text(font: "Liberation Sans", size: 9.5pt, fill: rgb("{{textColorDark}}"))
#let themeColor = rgb("{{themeColor}}")
#let textColorLight = rgb("{{textColorLight}}")
#let textColorMuted = rgb("{{textColorMuted}}")

#grid(
  columns: (34%, 66%),
  rows: (100%),
  block(
    fill: themeColor,
    width: 100%,
    height: 100%,
    inset: 22pt,
    [
      #set text(fill: textColorLight)
      #align(center)[
        #block(radius: 50%, clip: true, width: 85pt, height: 85pt, stroke: 3pt + textColorLight, fill: rgb("#ffffff25"))[
          #align(center + horizon)[#text(size: 24pt, weight: "bold")[{{initials}}]]
        ]
      ]
      #v(15pt)
      #text(weight: "bold", size: 10.5pt, tracking: 1pt)[CONTACTO]
      #v(3pt)
      #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.8pt + textColorLight)
      #v(6pt)
      #if "{{phone}}" != "" [*Tel:* {{phone}} \]
      #if "{{email}}" != "" [*Email:* {{email}} \]
      #if "{{address}}" != "" [*Ubicación:* {{address}} \]
      #if "{{website}}" != "" [*Web:* {{website}} \]
      
      #v(20pt)
      #text(weight: "bold", size: 10.5pt, tracking: 1pt)[HABILIDADES]
      #v(3pt)
      #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.8pt + textColorLight)
      #v(6pt)
      {{skillsListTypst}}
    ]
  ),
  block(
    inset: (x: 25pt, top: 30pt, bottom: 25pt),
    width: 100%,
    height: 100%,
    [
      #text(size: 24pt, weight: "bold", fill: themeColor)[{{fullName}}]
      #v(-3pt)
      #text(size: 12pt, weight: "medium", fill: textColorMuted)[{{title}}]
      #v(8pt)
      #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.5pt + themeColor)
      #v(12pt)
      {{sectionsTypst}}
    ]
  )
)
modern:
#set page(paper: "a4", margin: (x: 22pt, top: 22pt, bottom: 22pt))
#set text(font: "Liberation Sans", size: 9.5pt, fill: rgb("{{textColorDark}}"))
#let themeColor = rgb("{{themeColor}}")
#let textColorMuted = rgb("{{textColorMuted}}")

#block(width: 100%, inset: (bottom: 12pt), stroke: (bottom: 2.5pt + themeColor))[
  #grid(
    columns: (auto, 1fr),
    gutter: 15pt,
    block(radius: 50%, width: 55pt, height: 55pt, fill: themeColor)[
      #align(center + horizon)[#text(size: 18pt, weight: "bold", fill: white)[{{initials}}]]
    ],
    [
      #v(4pt)
      #text(size: 24pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("{{textColorDark}}"))[{{fullName}}]
      #v(-2pt)
      #text(size: 12pt, weight: "medium", fill: themeColor)[{{title}}]
      #v(3pt)
      #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: textColorMuted)[{{email}} | {{phone}} | {{website}}]
    ]
  )
]
#v(15pt)
#grid(
  columns: (2.4fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 20pt,
  [{{sectionsTypst}}],
  [
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 10.5pt, fill: themeColor)[HABILIDADES]
    #v(6pt)
    {{skillsListTypst}}
    #v(18pt)
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 10.5pt, fill: themeColor)[CONTACTO]
    #v(6pt)
    #if "{{email}}" != "" [Email: {{email}} \]
    #if "{{phone}}" != "" [Tel: {{phone}} \]
    #if "{{website}}" != "" [Web: {{website}} \]
    #if "{{address}}" != "" [Ubicación: {{address}} \]
  ]
)
